title: Among Marvel Comics superheroes with missing weight data and more than 15 s
question: Among Marvel Comics superheroes with missing weight data and more than 15 superpowers, find the one with the highest Strength attribute value. Return their full name, number of superpowers, and Strength score.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s."XCL_020" AS full_name,
       COUNT(hp."XCL_013") AS num_superpowers,
       ha."XCL_011" AS strength_score
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s."XCL_018" = hp."XCL_012"
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s."XCL_018" = ha."XCL_009"
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s."XCL_029" IS NULL
  AND a."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
GROUP BY s."XCL_018", s."XCL_020", ha."XCL_011"
HAVING COUNT(hp."XCL_013") > 15
ORDER BY ha."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s."XCL_020" AS full_name,
       COUNT(hp."XCL_013") AS num_superpowers,
       ha."XCL_011" AS strength_score
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s."XCL_018" = hp."XCL_012"
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s."XCL_018" = ha."XCL_009"
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s."XCL_029" IS NULL
  AND a."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
GROUP BY s."XCL_018", s."XCL_020", ha."XCL_011"
HAVING COUNT(hp."XCL_013") > 15
ORDER BY ha."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
